text:
Elena (Marketing): Brain dump: want a hands-on webinar that actually leaves engineers with artifacts. Idea: 40m short talks + 20m interactive labs (3 rotations). Prefer rotations over concurrent breakouts to increase exposure.
Tom (Host): Rotations could be slick but might be heavy on time switching. How long per rotation?
Elena (Marketing): Thinking 6m intro + 4 x 5m rotations = 20m (each attendee gets two rotations). Quick transitions.
Ravi (Growth): Rotations help us tag interests in HubSpot (rotation selection -> property). We can use a midday poll to seed routing.
Nina (Product): Product can run "latency profiling" rotation and "autoscale policy" rotation. Marco can do the live KV-cache demo.
Marco (Eng): I can do a 5m live snippet showing batching config + one-liner perf gains. Will prepare a recorded fallback.
Claire (Speaker Ops): Guest confirmed: Dr. Rivera for the evaluation/litmus rotation. Need 2 slides + 1 demo gif from each speaker by Wed EOD.
Dr. Rivera (Guest): Ill share a 90s gif of the eval harness run and 2 talking bullets.
Elena (Marketing): Draft run-of-show v1 (all times PT):
```
11:00 - Host welcome + housekeeping (Tom) - 3m
11:03 - Rapid context: where inference costs hide - 7m (Elena + Nina)
11:10 - Rotation instructions + poll - 3m
11:13 - Rotation 1 - 5m
11:18 - Rotation 2 - 5m
11:23 - Rotation 3 - 5m
11:28 - Rotation 4 - 5m
11:33 - 10m panel Q&A seeded from rotations
11:43 - CTA + asset links + survey - 7m
```
Tom (Host): Can we shave one rotation and give 15m Q&A? engineers like long Q&A.
Ravi (Growth): Long Q&A is high-touch but lowers capacity. Alternatively, keep rotations and run a 10m live Q + 5m rapid-fire. Also add a click-to-download for lab templates as a gated MQL.
Elena (Marketing): Good call. We'll keep four rotations but reduce opening talk from 7m to 5m. Update: keynote -> 5m; rotations unchanged; Q&A = 10m + 5m rapid.
Claire (Speaker Ops): Logistics: we'll use Zoom breakouts for rotations and a Google form to collect rotation choices pre-event. Need copy for landing page that lists rotation names and short outcomes.
Marco (Eng): Zoom breakouts can be messy at scale. Can we instead host rotation rooms as short live streams with panelists and a central chat? Less switching.
Nina (Product): Streams lose the interactive feel. Maybe hybrid: small groups via breakouts, but have a backchannel Slack/Discord for questions and a central stream for the host.
Elena (Marketing): Hybrid sounds right. We'll add Slack invite to the confirmation email. Also plan for a post-event on-demand landing page with per-rotation clips.
InfraBot: rehearsal-env provisioned: rwdw-rotations-175111. Recording endpoints enabled.
Elena (Marketing): Promo headline draft: "Engineered inference: bite-sized labs to cut latency and cost". CTA: "Reserve a spot + pick your labs".
Ravi (Growth): Add "Get the lab templates + benchmark script" in the CTA. Also we should include a one-question pre-event poll about primary pain (cost/latency/accuracy) to tailor examples.
Tom (Host): Ill take hosting notes and collect top rotation questions live. Also propose a script line to seed discussion: "What's the single knob you wish you could tune to save 30% on inference cost?"
Claire (Speaker Ops): Action checklist: 1) speakers deliver 2 slides + demo gif by Wed EOD; 2) Marco records fallback 2-min clip; 3) Elena finalizes landing + Slack invite copy; 4) Ravi wires HubSpot mapping for rotations; 5) Tom preps host script. Rehearsals: tech check = 1751180000, full dress = 1751256400.
Marco (Eng): I'll upload the demo gif and a terminal snippet to the greenroom folder. Example snippet: `python run_demo.py --batch=64 --quant=int8`
Dr. Rivera (Guest): Thanks all  looking forward. Please share the greenroom link.
Elena (Marketing): Final note: cadence to promote: week-of email + two social pushes + partner co-promotion. We'll also seed a short benchmark highlight on social the day before to drive clicks. :rocket:
